githubnext/gh-aw-cao.summary: Policy-gated control plane running review-first agentic campaigns across repo fleets.
highlights: docs/admission.md: pre-activation admission gates, narrow-only dispatch

rshade/gh-aw-fleet.summary: Declarative fleet manager (fleet.json) that reconciles gh-aw installs via PRs and reports AIC consumption.
highlights: Thin orchestrator over gh aw add/update/upgrade
consumption subcommand rolls up cost by repo/profile/workflow

highlights: Never fails the workflow on API errors

githubnext/agentics.summary: Official sample family of reusable workflows (triage, CI Doctor, Repo Assist, reviewers); very active, 969 stars.
highlights: README.md: categorized catalog with docs/ per workflow

githubnext/agentic-ops.summary: Installable bundle (gh aw add) for daily AIC spend audit and conservative optimization.
highlights: Single root package, no extra secrets

petermefrandsen/gh-aw-inspector.summary: VS Code extension to discover, run and evaluate gh-aw workflows; low activity since Feb 2026.
